system_prompt: You are taking a test on your knowledge of the chemical composition of mushrooms. Answer strictly in JSON using exactly these keys: {"гриб": "...", "состав": [{"вещество": "...", "содержание": "...", "влияние": "..."}]} (mushroom / composition list / compound / amount / effect). In «влияние» give one short sentence about the compound's effect on humans. List the main chemical compounds of this mushroom. No text outside the JSON.
